subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Thomas <evan.thomas@novatech.com>, Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@novatech.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Hi Evan / Natalie — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the asks I promised:

- Recap: we covered integration options (hosted API vs Dedicated), privacy needs, and a rough traffic profile. You indicated most volume will be chat generation for customer support, with embeddings for semantic search and a small rerank flow for high-value queries.

Action items for NovaTech (can you confirm by EOD?):
1) Ballpark monthly token volume (avg tokens per request * requests/day OR a monthly total).
2) Preferred budget range for inference (monthly committed/opportunity to pilot).
3) Per-model split (approx % of total tokens for chat vs embeddings vs rerank).
4) Any strict SLAs or region constraints (we heard US-first).

If it's helpful I attached a one-tab workbook template you can drop numbers into — just populate the rough monthly counts and we’ll run a cost/ROI back-of-envelope. Once we have that I’ll send a proposed unit economics table (target $/1M tokens by model) and a recommended pilot scope.

Attached: nova volume template (novatech_volume_breakdown.xlsx)

Next steps I propose:
- You share the workbook this week
- I send a 1-page pricing model and a suggested 6-week pilot (no credit card required)
- Quick engineering sync with your infra lead if pilot looks good

Thanks — I’ll follow up on pricing details once I have the numbers.

—Marissa

From: Evan Thomas <evan.thomas@novatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Marissa — thanks, sending a quick first pass. I filled the workbook and attached it (novatech_volume_breakdown.xlsx). High level: we are still early but here's our current estimate and budget guidance.

Estimated monthly tokens (Rough):
- Chat (support agent responses + system prompts): 120,000,000 tokens/month
- Embeddings (semantic search indexing + queries): 20,000,000 tokens/month
- Rerank (small subset of search results): 5,000,000 tokens/month
- Total: ~145,000,000 tokens/month

Budget range: our finance team is comfortable with $35k — $60k / month for the initial pilot + production ramp. We are aiming for an operating cost target around $/1M tokens in the low-mid hundreds — call it $300–$450 per 1M tokens as a starting negotiation point.

Questions for you:
- How do you recommend we think about embeddings pricing (per-vector vs token)? We track embeddings as calls per query + index build.
- For chat are the token counts including both prompt + completion? We counted both.

Also, we have a security questionnaire that DevSecOps will send if we move forward.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Thomas | Head of AI Platform | NovaTech
evan.thomas@novatech.com | (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Thomas <evan.thomas@novatech.com>, Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@novatech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Evan — awesome, this is exactly what we need. Quick answers + a proposed unit economics table attached (redwood_pricing_model_mix.pdf). Summary below so the execs have a one-page view.

Assumptions: your counts include prompt + completion for chat (good). Embeddings usage is treated as an API op — we can convert to tokens for a unified view but keep in mind embedding costs are typically charged per request / vector size. For a simplified comparison we modeled embeddings as equivalent token work based on your index build frequency.

Proposed high-level pricing (indicative for pilot; final price depends on committed volume and contract term):
- Chat (generation) — recommended unit economics: $320 per 1M tokens (prompt+completion)
- Embeddings (semantic search) — modeled as $85 per 1M tokens equivalent (or we can price per-embedding call at $0.0008 / 768-dim vector; pick whichever maps better to your telemetry)
- Rerank (short-context, high-QPS) — $150 per 1M tokens

Using your split (chat 120M, embeddings 20M, rerank 5M):
- Chat: 120M tokens => $38,400 / month
- Embeddings: 20M tokens => $1,700 / month
- Rerank: 5M tokens => $750 / month
- Estimated total: $40,850 / month (~$281 per 1M tokens effective across the mix)

Notes and levers:
- If you commit to a 6–12 month reserved capacity contract, we can reduce Chat unit to ~$250/1M and embeddings to ~$65/1M (saves ~20–25%).
- Autoscaling burst capacity and prefix caching can drive down effective tokens by 10–30% depending on reuse. We can run a trace-based simulation once you share sample logs.
- For embeddings, consider batching index builds and using a lower-dim embedding for lower-cost queries.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_model_mix.pdf (1-pager), novatech_volume_breakdown.xlsx (your sheet with our annotations).

Suggested next steps:
1) Approve the pilot budget band (~$40k/mo pilot with optional reserved discounts) — we can convert to a PO and pilot SOW.
2) Schedule 30-min engineering call for week of Dec 15 to walk infra and sample telemetry (I’ll include an infra contact).
3) If acceptable, we’ll draft a 6-week pilot SOW and an initial contract with a 6-month optional reserved term.

I’m looping Rishi (contracts) on this thread so he can prep an SOW and redlines. Also happy to jump on a quick call with your procurement.

—Marissa

Marissa — thank you, very helpful. The modeled numbers look reasonable and are aligned with our internal target of $300–$400 per 1M tokens across the mix. We’re happy to proceed with the pilot at the $40k/month modeled spend.

Next items from our side:

Also, can you include a short bullet in the SOW about data retention (30 days KV cache/14 days logs) and SOC 2 availability for Dedicated later in the contract?

Thanks — Evan
